name: moving-line
title: Scroll Progress Line
blurb: Vertical line shrinks from top based on scroll progress.
description: Renders an SVG vertical line that retracts from the top as the user scrolls. Uses a gradient stroke with spring-based animation tracking scroll progress.
use_when: Long-form content or pages where a visual scroll progress indicator helps users understand document length.
avoid_when: Short pages or non-scroll contexts where the line indicator is not meaningful.
a11y: Purely visual scroll progress indicator with no semantic content or keyboard interaction.
